Per-site dispositions (origin/main @1504d096ceca — tree moved since the ticket was authored). Following the operator-approved principle: compose_config()-reads resolve the CODE root; git ops on the store's OWN repo keep the STORE root, routed through ONE shared seam.

CODE ROOT (via config.repo_root_or_none(), behavior-changing on a relocated store — RED→GREEN in tests/unit/test_relocated_store_repo_root.py):
- reads.py:238  _sync_disabled(...)          sync.pull    -> repo_root_or_none()
- reads.py:249  tickets_branch(...)          tickets.branch -> repo_root_or_none()
- reads.py:374  _load_scratch compose_config scratch.base_dir -> repo_root_or_none()

STORE ROOT via NEW shared seam rebar._proc.store_repo_root(tracker) == dirname(realpath(tracker)) (behavior-preserving; these operate git -C <tracker> on the store's OWN repo or attribute against it:
- _proc.py:141              detached_child_cwd (uses local seam; stdlib-only leaf, cannot import rebar._store)
- compact_txn.py:523        authorship ledger repo_root
- compact_rebuild.py:138    authorship ledger repo_root
- compact_plan.py:211       attribution_fields repo_root
- fsck.py:252               dir-mismatch hint repo_guess
- fsck_tracker_health.py:82/203/373  store's own branch/remote for the health probe
- freshness.py:80  _remote_ref (NEW site, not in original list) store's own remote/branch for the staleness ancestry probe — mirrors fsck._tracker_sync_status

STORE ROOT already sanctioned in place (str-form, NOT edited — avoids collision with baldish-regainable-steed on sync.py):
- sync.py:305/307  # repo-root-ok: branch/remote of the STORE's own git repo

Seam placement: rebar._proc (the stdlib-only process-helpers leaf) so _proc's detached_child_cwd can route through it WITHOUT breaking its no-rebar-imports invariant, while _commands/_store callers import it freely. Single choke point => no caller hand-rolls dirname(...tracker...).

Guard (AC#3 / folds feisty-intense-mandrill): extend check_repo_root_from_tracker.py to unwrap str()/os.path.realpath()/os.path.abspath()/realpath()/abspath() AND dirname(StorePaths(tracker).canonical). Exempts the seam via a distinct '# repo-root-seam:' marker (so the existing 'only sync.py may carry # repo-root-ok' self-test stays intact); '# repo-root-ok:' still exempts store-root sites. Self-test inverts the old 'realpath/abspath NOT unwrapped' case and adds .canonical/str cases + a seam-marker case.
EOF
)
